source: BK4 printed p.75 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.81; no errata
note: Wires image-read at 300 dpi from the p.75 program list and diagram (PDF p.81); all 8 match programs.json; the errata sheet has no Book IV page 74-76 entry, so wires = as_printed. The slide-switch convention (RIGHT: 'input A is now 0'; LEFT: 'Input A is now 1') and the pushbutton convention are printed in the procedure itself. Switch target 1000 = RIGHT (arm S on T, V on W), target 0 = LEFT (S on R, V on U), per src/core/netlist.ts slide rows and jack-map R/U = LEFT, T/W = RIGHT. Four procedure steps, four expects, each asserting only the lamps the step names. Steps 2 and 3 name only light 6; light 5 is not asserted there (its OFF state would come from the p.74 A/B/Carry Out/Sum table plus p.75 'light 5 represents carry out', a derivation left for Step 7). The 500 ms advance lets lamps finish thermal transients; the page states no timing. The p.75 three-input table is not asserted (it needs carry in, which this circuit lacks).

script.cite: BK4 printed p.75 procedure = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.81
script.quote: Turn power ON. Move slide switch 6 to the RIGHT: input A is now 0. Do not push pushbutton 6: input B is 0. Light 5 and 6 are OFF: sum is 0 and carry out is 0.

script.cite: BK4 printed p.75 procedure = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.81
script.quote: Push pushbutton 6 and hold it down. Input B is now 1. Light 6 comes ON, indicating that the sum is 1.

script.cite: BK4 printed p.75 procedure = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.81
script.quote: Release pushbutton 6 and move slide switch 6 to the LEFT. Input A is now 1; input B is 0. Light 6 comes ON, indicating that the sum is 1: 1 + 0 = 1.

script.cite: BK4 printed p.75 procedure = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.81
script.quote: With the slide switch LEFT, push pushbutton 6. Light 6 goes OFF and light 5 comes ON.
